channel.title: TailRef Studio — News
channel.description: Release notes and development updates for TailRef Studio, a free and open-source reference board, drawing workspace and 3D pose tool for artists.

item.title: TailRef is now playable in your browser
item.description: Press Run tool on the itch.io page and the workspace opens in your browser: drop in references, arrange the board, draw, pose. Here is what the demo can and cannot do.

item.title: TailRef Studio 1.4.4 is out — now on macOS
item.description: Native builds for Apple silicon and Intel, .tail boards that open from Finder, a release check that starts the packaged app before shipping, and a long pass over the settings panel.

item.title: TailRef Studio 1.4.3 is out — now on Linux
item.description: AppImage, deb and rpm builds with desktop integration and file associations. The native inkcore module is now compiled per platform instead of shipping a Windows binary.

item.title: TailRef Studio 1.4.2 is out — and it updates itself now
item.description: The first build on itch.io: automatic updates from GitHub Releases, GPL-3.0-or-later licensing and a full security audit pass.
